messages:
maria: EOD async check-in for audits/vuln remediation/IAM+KMS. Quick summary: rotated test keys (dry-run), opened a CR for the vault perms, blocker on staging key rotation (403). Details below.

raj: Done today: merged audit-scan false-positive filter (PR #4521). Blocker: cannot trigger key-rotation job in staging due to 403 from KMS. Pinged infra.

taylor: @maria ping — I can review #4521 after standup, :eyes:. Noted earlier error was a config mismatch, fixed in patch.

liam: Ran a dry-run locally to validate rotation flow:
```
$ ./scripts/rotate-keys --env=staging --dry-run
INFO: loading keys from projects/redwood-staging/locations/global/keyRings/test
ERROR: KMS API call failed: 403 Forbidden
Trace: google.api.exceptions.PermissionDenied: Service account missing roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```
Blocker confirmed.

nina: I temporarily added the role to the service account so liam could run the dry-run. I will revert after we confirm. Put the terraform diff in PR #4532 — includes the policy snippet.

sec-bot: automated-scan: new moderate vuln detected in dependency graphql-js (GHSA-xxxx). Suggested upgrade to >=16.0.0. Created ticket SEC-789. No immediate production exposure detected.

maria: Blocker: until staging perms are fixed we can't finish the canary. @ops-bot can you escalate to infra oncall and request a short exception or IaC change?

ops-bot: INFRA ticket created: INFRA-1221 — assigned to raj, priority P2, ETA ~2h. Notifying infra-oncall.

raj: I'll take INFRA-1221. For a faster unblock, @nina can you paste the exact policy you applied so I mirror it in IaC?

nina: policy snippet pasted: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on resource `projects/redwood-staging/locations/global/keyRings/test`. Added audit-log note in PR.

liam: After perms are in place we'll run the full rotation smoke: curl-based smoke to validate token exchange and decrypt path. Example test: `curl -X POST https://staging-api.internal/redwood/v1/test-rotate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}'` — expecting 200 within 300ms.

taylor: I reviewed #4521 and left one small nit in the tests. Will approve once CI is green. If approvals land, we can merge and kick a full scan tomorrow morning.

maria: Today's plan (short): 1) finish CRs (taylor/raj), 2) verify staging rotation once INFRA-1221 is done (liam/nina), 3) run full audit scan tomorrow AM and triage SEC-789. If perms fixed earlier we'll try a quick canary tonight.

nina: Thanks — will revert temp policy after successful dry-run and post the PR link here. :thumbsup:

taylor: :raised_hands:

ops-bot: infra-oncall update: infra acknowledged INFRA-1221, working on IaC patch and short-lived exception path. Will update thread when done.
